decisions.reason: The modular MMAK concept is central to the firm's announced direction of modular, cleaner solutions, and it is publicly backed by a quantified customer success story, so management is strongly committed to it.
The slow-speed shredder has kept its own page for two years and sits close to the core offer, though the newer slow-speed shredder line E could eventually absorb or replace this single model.

This multi-model MMAK product line carries the firm's flagship public reference case with Wiese Umwelt Service and embodies the strategic modular direction, so the investment and visible commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
The slow-speed shredder line was launched only in 2024 with several models and its own page, so it represents fresh investment whose results are too early to judge.
The spiral shaft screen line is a recent multi-model investment that extends the core screening offer, and any weak early results can still be attributed to the ramp-up phase.
